IMAGE='docker.io/library/oraclelinux@sha256:d8c0a1f95f3394a2b40ece95dbff199cea94d06ac0ed354a7b88e96e2df5bb94'
PINS={HELPER:'58c692a775a2dffdaa6be86866cdb15ddb307f97aeb8a04b4f7c737ea56c3627',CLI:'60028870931ea6e91955bfeaee358ec6c6920f6162c17a3d828c3c82ab3c3599',HOME/'.docker/config.json':'f173396ef80b3c0bf4f8a5f6f944d3e426cee041ae3a2a8a07602ff6846a9f1a',META:'c16649b1a2f1c6fbb68b85158a956862331e86543e25df46341f5fe5df2f9a25'}
SHELL='''set -eu
printf '\n@@OS@@\n'; cat /etc/os-release
printf '\n@@KERNEL@@\n'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease
printf '\n@@CGROUP@@\n'; cat /proc/self/cgroup
printf '\n@@MEMORY@@\n'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max
printf '\n@@SWAP@@\n'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.swap.max
printf '\n@@PIDS@@\n'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.max
printf '\n@@CORE@@\n'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern
printf '\n@@SUID_DUMPABLE@@\n'; cat /proc/sys/fs/suid_dumpable
printf '\n@@MEMSTAT@@\n'; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.stat
printf '\n@@PYTHON@@\n'; command -v python3.11 || true

def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def require(value):
 if not value: raise ValueError('PROFILE_REFUSED')
def pins():
 require(all(sha(p)==expected for p,expected in PINS.items()))
 m=json.loads(META.read_bytes())
 require(m['Endpoints']['docker']['Host']=='npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine' or m['Endpoints']['docker']['Host']=='npipe://./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine')
def save(path,value):
 raw=(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode('utf8')
 require(len(raw)<=262144)
 tmp=path.with_name(path.name+'.tmp')
 with tmp.open('xb') as f:
  f.write(raw); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
 os.replace(tmp,path)
def own(info,*,name,task,image):
 require(info['Name']=='/'+name and info['Config']['Labels'].get('maskgw.task')==task)
 require(info['Image']==image and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',info['Id']) is not None)
 return info['Id']
def profile(info,*,image):
 cfg,h=info['Config'],info['HostConfig']
 require(cfg['Image']==image and cfg['User']=='65534:65534')
 require(cfg['Entrypoint']==['/bin/sh'] and cfg['Cmd']==['-c',SHELL])
 require(cfg['Healthcheck']['Test']==['NONE'] and not info['Mounts'])
 require(h['ReadonlyRootfs'] is True and h['Privileged'] is False)
 require(h['Memory']==134217728 and h['MemorySwap']==134217728 and h['PidsLimit']==16)
 require(h['NanoCpus']==1000000000 and h['ShmSize']==1048576)
 require(h['NetworkMode']=='none' and h['IpcMode']=='private' and h['CgroupnsMode']=='private')
 require(not h.get('PidMode') and not h.get('UTSMode') and not h.get('Init'))
 require(h['RestartPolicy']['Name']=='no' and h['LogConfig']['Type']=='none')
 require(h['CapDrop']==['ALL'] and not h.get('CapAdd'))
 require(h['SecurityOpt'] in [['no-new-privileges'],['no-new-privileges=true']])
 require(not any(h.get(n) for n in ['Binds','PortBindings','Devices','DeviceRequests']))
 require({v['Name']:(v['Soft'],v['Hard']) for v in h['Ulimits']}=={'nofile':(64,64),'core':(0,0)} and len(h['Ulimits'])==2)

async def main():
 require(sys.flags.optimize==0 and ROOT.name.startswith('maskgw-oracle9-base-20261023-'))
 require(ROOT.parent.resolve()==(HOME/'AppData/Local/Temp').resolve())
 state_path=ROOT/'attempt.json'
 state=json.loads(state_path.read_bytes())
 require(state.get('kind')=='maskgw-oracle9-base' and state.get('invoked') is False and state.get('phase')=='APP_READY')
 require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{32}',state['task']) is not None and not (ROOT/'result.json').exists())
 pins()
 state['invoked']=True; state['phase']='BASE_PROBE_CONSUMED'; save(state_path,state)
 mod=runpy.run_path(str(HELPER)); bounded=mod['bounded']
 class OwnedWatchdog:
  def __init__(self):
   self.container_id=None;self.done=threading.Event();self.fired=threading.Event();self.failed=False
   self.thread=threading.Thread(target=self.run,name='maskgw-ol9-base-watchdog',daemon=False)
  def run(self):
   if not self.done.wait(240):
    self.fired.set()
    if self.container_id is not None:
     try:
      pins()
      result=subprocess.run([str(CLI),'--context','desktop-linux','kill','--signal','KILL',self.container_id],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,env=mod['environment'](),timeout=5,check=False)
      self.failed=result.returncode!=0
     except BaseException:self.failed=True
  def start(self):self.thread.start()
  def close(self):
   self.done.set();self.thread.join(timeout=7)
   require(not self.thread.is_alive() and not self.failed)
 watchdog=OwnedWatchdog()
 result={'profile':'oracle9-base','task':state['task'],'image':IMAGE,'commands':[],'owned_cleanup':False,'inventory_restored':False,'outcome':'PENDING','create_attempted':False}
 name='maskgw-ol9-base-'+state['task'][:12]
 result['name']=name
 cid=None; image_id=None
 async def cli(label,*args,timeout=5,limit=262144):
  pins()
  rc,raw=await bounded([str(CLI),'--context','desktop-linux',*args],timeout=timeout,limit=limit)
  result['commands'].append({'name':label,'exit':rc,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
  return rc,raw
 async def inspect(target):
  rc,raw=await cli('inspect-own','inspect',target)
  require(rc==0)
  data=json.loads(raw); require(type(data) is list and len(data)==1)
  return data[0]
 try:
  rc,raw=await cli('version','version','--format','{{json .Server}}')
  require(rc==0)
  v=json.loads(raw); require(v['Os']=='linux' and v['Arch']=='amd64')
  result['engine']={k:v.get(k) for k in ['Version','Os','Arch','KernelVersion']}
  rc,raw=await cli('inventory-before','ps','-aq','--no-trunc')
  require(rc==0 and not raw.strip())
  watchdog.start()
  rc,_=await cli('pull','pull','--quiet','--platform','linux/amd64',IMAGE,timeout=120,limit=65536)
  require(rc==0)
  rc,raw=await cli('image','image','inspect',IMAGE)
  require(rc==0)
  images=json.loads(raw); require(type(images) is list and len(images)==1)
  image=images[0]
  require(image['Os']=='linux' and image['Architecture']=='amd64' and image['Id'].startswith('sha256:'))
  require(not image['Config'].get('Volumes'))
  require(any('d8c0a1f95f3394a2b40ece95dbff199cea94d06ac0ed354a7b88e96e2df5bb94' in d for d in image['RepoDigests']))
  image_id=image['Id'];result['image_id']=image_id
  result['image_metadata']={k:image.get(k) for k in ['Architecture','Os','Size','Created','RepoDigests']}
  result['create_attempted']=True;save(ROOT/'progress.json',result)
  rc,raw=await cli('create','create','--pull','never','--name',name,'--label','maskgw.task='+state['task'],'--network','none','--ipc','private','--cgroupns','private','--read-only','--user','65534:65534','--cap-drop','ALL','--security-opt','no-new-privileges=true','--memory','128m','--memory-swap','128m','--pids-limit','16','--cpus','1','--shm-size','1m','--ulimit','nofile=64:64','--ulimit','core=0:0','--restart','no','--log-driver','none','--no-healthcheck','--entrypoint','/bin/sh',image_id,'-c',SHELL)
  require(rc==0 and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',raw.decode('ascii').strip()) is not None)
  cid=raw.decode('ascii').strip();result['cid']=cid
  info=await inspect(cid);require(own(info,name=name,task=state['task'],image=image_id)==cid)
  profile(info,image=image_id);watchdog.container_id=cid
  rc,raw=await cli('metadata','start','--attach',cid,timeout=20,limit=16384)
  require(rc==0)
  (ROOT/'metadata.txt').open('xb').write(raw)
  text=raw.decode('utf8','strict'); parts={}
  for piece in text.split('\n@@')[1:]:
   marker,body=piece.split('@@\n',1);require(marker not in parts);parts[marker]=body.strip()
  require(set(parts)=={'OS','KERNEL','CGROUP','MEMORY','SWAP','PIDS','CORE','SUID_DUMPABLE','MEMSTAT','PYTHON'})
  osdata=dict(line.split('=',1) for line in parts['OS'].splitlines() if '=' in line)
  require(osdata.get('ID','').strip('"')=='ol' and osdata.get('VERSION_ID','').strip('"')=='9.8')
  require(parts['MEMORY']=='134217728' and parts['SWAP']=='0' and parts['PIDS']=='16')
  require(any(line.startswith('kernel ') for line in parts['MEMSTAT'].splitlines()))
  result['metadata']=parts
  info=await inspect(cid);require(own(info,name=name,task=state['task'],image=image_id)==cid)
  require(info['State']['Running'] is False and info['State']['ExitCode']==0 and info['State']['OOMKilled'] is False)

 except BaseException:
  result['outcome']='BASE_METADATA_NOT_PASSED'
 finally:
  try:
   if result['create_attempted']:
    info=await inspect(cid or name)
    cid=own(info,name=name,task=state['task'],image=image_id)

  if not result['owned_cleanup'] or not result['inventory_restored']:result['outcome']='BASE_METADATA_NOT_PASSED'
  save(ROOT/'result.json',result)
 print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
 return 0 if result['outcome']=='BASE_METADATA_PASSED' else 2
